scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery store closure, fire, or disaster
canceled/suspended emergency food distributions after storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction

coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption identified within the bounded prior-hour window. Fresh/recent hits were non-qualifying, outside the window, outside the U.S., or showed emergency food distribution continuing as scheduled.
notable_exclusions: Kaua'i hurricane recovery update: emergency food distributions and North Shore Food Pantry distribution were proceeding as scheduled.
Wilson, NY only-grocery-store fire was from January 2025, outside the window.
Smooth Rock Falls pantry closure was in Ontario, Canada, outside U.S. scope.
coverage_notes.production_authority: Supplementary recall watch only; production collection remains authoritative.
